findings.title: Final note verification relearns a replacement saved-copy baseline
findings.evidence: assertPersistedNotesReadable compares only array_column(id) with the original expected collections, admits a newly read persisted snapshot against current notes, then compares raw snapshot bytes to that same newly read model.
findings.trigger: A reached prepare/accept audit callback coherently changes both saved note copies, persisted note content and their origin text digests, retaining IDs/actor/type/time/original Site/person and creation audit. The new content can satisfy every comparison without agreeing with the immutable originally selected copy. Saved metadata-only changes are also unbound by the ID-only comparison.
findings.impact: The transition can accept different note content or metadata from the intended reviewed handover. Existing single-side mutation/removal controls do not exercise this coherent replacement.
findings.required_change: Bind the complete selected saved-note tuple, origin and saved metadata to the immutable pre-write expected value with only explicitly justified normalisation. Retain that baseline through final raw validation after normal callbacks; do not relearn it from fresh().
findings.acceptance: Reached prepare and accept coherent persisted-note/snapshot/digest rewrites and metadata-only mutation must roll back the whole transition; retain unchanged positive cases and all existing role/Site/source/version guards.
